mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (indicating a tightening labor market) is associated with stronger corporate earnings growth and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between UNRATE and 20d forward returns is negative or insignificant (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has a negative Rank IC with 60d forward returns, or the positive returns are not observed when both series increase by more than 1% in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of robust industrial production growth (INDPRO > 1.0% month-over-month), the expansionary economic momentum supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 1.0%, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in this regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between PAYEMS and 5d forward returns is negative or insignificant (p > 0.05) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate (HOUST) above 2000 thousand units signals strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when HOUST > 2000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) signals a 'Goldilocks' economy with strong growth and controlled inflation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS * UNRATE) has a negative Rank IC with 60d forward returns, or the positive returns are not observed when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% year-over-year), the central bank is likely to tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL in this regime is above -0.03.
